issue.title: bob-plugins test-command-mode-sheet-sequence-dom fails npm test on hosts without Chromium instead of skipping
issue.description:
`npm test` in bob-plugins fails on apollo because `scripts/test-command-mode-sheet-sequence-dom.cjs` ("production sheet render and clicks use real DOM APIs") throws `Could not find Chromium. Set CHROMIUM_PATH to a browser executable.` from `findChromium()` when none of google-chrome, google-chrome-stable, chromium, or chromium-browser is on PATH. The test was added in bf90ba0 (fix(command-mode): repair sequence sheet DOM, args, and RECENT state, epic bob-cli-er).

Root cause: `findChromium()` throws instead of the test skipping (`t.skip(...)`) when no browser exists, so every agent running the full plugin suite on a Chromium-less host sees a red suite and has to re-verify that the failure is pre-existing (bob-cli-ez.4, ez.5, ez.6 and the bob-cli-ez land agent all hit it).

Fix: either skip with a clear reason when Chromium is absent (keeping it a hard failure when `CHROMIUM_PATH` is set but invalid, or under CI), or install Chromium on apollo. Proposed by bob-cli-ez.4 (note #1) and routed by the bob-cli-ez land agent.
